newsitem.title: UK: AUGUST IPE GAS OIL DELIVERY 77,800 T - OFFICIAL.
newsitem.headline: AUGUST IPE GAS OIL DELIVERY 77,800 T - OFFICIAL.

text.p: Physical delivery against the expired IPE August gas oil futures contract will be 778 lots, or 77,800 tonnes, an IPE official said on Tuesday.
Traders said the delivery was in line with expectations.
Deliveries against the July contract totalled 1,223 lots, or 122,300 tonnes. The June contract expiry saw a delivery of 1,360 lots or 136,000 tonnes.
The November 1996 contract expiry saw a record 865,100 tonnes delivered and May 1996 saw the lowest delivery ever, of 12,600 tonnes.
